title: 游戏内容与后期深度不足
description: 游戏内容匮乏，中后期缺乏多样性和深度，重复性高，玩家很快失去目标和继续游玩的动力。
evidence: Ostranauts still lacks variety in the mid-to-end gameplay loop. Much of the implied complexity regarding managing ships and your characters has yet to be implemented, so there really isn't much left to learn after you have salvaged a dozen or so ships.
the game is really repetitive and consist mostly into uninstalling always the same 10 components who have a sort of value at the market

evidence_items.quote: there is very limited progression
evidence_items.description: 游戏进程非常有限
evidence_items.quote_zh: 进度非常有限

evidence_items.quote: You spend dozens of hours salvaging ship parts (the SAME ship parts over and over, since there aren't that many of them, by the way)
evidence_items.description: 反复打捞相同的飞船部件，重复性高
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你花上几十个小时打捞飞船部件（顺便说一句，是同样的飞船部件一遍又一遍，因为这类部件本来就不多）

evidence_items.quote: the gameplay quickly becomes stale as you're caught in a repetitive grind for cash that you don't even really need that much
evidence_items.description: 游戏很快陷入重复刷钱的枯燥循环
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏玩法很快就会变得乏味，因为你陷入了一场重复性的刷钱苦工，而你其实并不那么需要那些钱

evidence_items.quote: Once your starting ship's mortgage is paid, the game loses all form of purpose and drive
evidence_items.description: 还清房贷后游戏失去目标和动力
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你初始飞船的贷款还清，游戏就失去了所有目标和动力

evidence_items.quote: how many systems just aren't deep at all... except maybe deeply repetitive
evidence_items.description: 许多系统缺乏深度，重复性强
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有多少系统根本毫无深度……也许只是深度重复

evidence_items.quote: within 15 hours or so you will be done with the game
evidence_items.description: 大约15小时就能通关，缺乏长期游玩内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大约15个小时内你就会把这游戏玩完

evidence_items.quote: Pay off debt = nothing to do but build ship and make more money
evidence_items.description: 还清债务后无事可做，只能造船赚钱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 还清债务=除了造船和赚更多钱之外无事可做

evidence_items.quote: Most development up to this point has been all QOL changes and very very little content. The roadmap doesn't seem to add anything like new equipment, new ships, scalable equipment and so on.
evidence_items.description: 开发重点在QOL改动，内容极少，路线图无新装备/飞船等
evidence_items.quote_zh: 到目前为止，大部分开发都只是生活质量改动，内容非常非常少。路线图似乎也没有添加任何像新装备、新飞船、可扩展装备之类的东西。

evidence_items.quote: once I had my start hull polished up and expanded on a bit, the game was out of steam for me
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容很快耗尽，扩张船只后就没有继续游玩的动力
evidence_items.quote_zh: 等我把初始船体打磨好并稍微扩建之后，这游戏对我来说就没劲了

evidence_items.quote: Once past that the game-play quality goes way down and gets grindy with bad mechanics.
evidence_items.description: 早期有趣，但后期游戏质量下降，变得重复繁琐且机制糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦过了那个阶段，游戏体验质量就会大幅下降，变得又肝又依赖糟糕的机制。

evidence_items.quote: there is no late game. I mean, you can do stuff at this point, but it does not feel rewarding anymore.
evidence_items.description: 缺乏后期内容，后期玩法不具回报感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有后期游戏。我的意思是，在这个阶段你可以做事情，但已经不再感觉有回报了。

evidence_items.quote: Right now, it's very stale with progression coming down to fly to location - load up on scraps - fly to location - fix a bunch of parts - fly to location - sell parts.
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环重复且进展缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 眼下，游戏非常乏味，进程无非就是飞到地点——装满废料——飞到地点——修一堆零件——飞到地点——卖掉零件。

evidence_items.quote: the game is really repetitive and consist mostly into uninstalling always the same 10 components who have a sort of value at the market
evidence_items.description: 游戏重复，反复拆装同样部件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏非常重复，主要就是一直卸载同样那10个在市场上有点价值的组件

evidence_items.quote: Ostranauts still lacks variety in the mid-to-end gameplay loop. Much of the implied complexity regarding managing ships and your characters has yet to be implemented, so there really isn't much left to learn after you have salvaged a dozen or so ships.
evidence_items.description: 中后期游戏循环缺乏多样性，管理飞船和角色的复杂性尚未实现
evidence_items.quote_zh: Ostranauts在中后期游戏循环中仍然缺乏多样性。关于管理飞船和角色的许多隐含复杂性尚未实现，所以在打捞了十几艘飞船之后，真的没什么可学的了。

evidence_items.quote: Feels like it needs more progression and direction for the player to follow
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏进度和方向感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 感觉它需要更多的进度推进和让玩家遵循的方向指引

evidence_items.quote: не допилили и те места, куда можно было бы на них полететь
evidence_items.description: 可前往的地点尚未完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 连那些本可以飞过去的地方也没做完

evidence_items.quote: ни лэйт-гейма
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有后期内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 也没有后期

evidence_items.quote: у игры по сути нет ни мидгейма
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有中期内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏实质上既没有中期

evidence_items.quote: aside from character creation there is no other kinds of 'progression'. So for example if you have a negative trait, you're stuck with it till you die and create a new char.
evidence_items.description: 除角色创建外没有其他成长途径，负面特质无法在游戏中移除
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了角色创建之外，没有其他任何形式的"成长"。所以举个例子，如果你有一个负面特质，你会一直带着它直到你死去并创建一个新角色。

evidence_items.quote: Very little stations and very shallow gameplay
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 空间站极少，玩法非常浅薄

evidence_items.quote: it feels like you run out of content to experience very quickly
evidence_items.description: 很快耗尽可体验内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 感觉你很快就会没有内容可体验了

evidence_items.quote: there isn't a whole lot to do after a dozen or so hours
evidence_items.description: 游玩十几小时后可做的事很少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩了十几个小时左右之后就没什么可做的了
